name: python-backend
description: RunAPI backend server with file-based routing

scripts.start: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const os = require('os'); const cmd = os.platform() === 'win32' ? 'venv\\Scripts\\runapi.exe' : 'venv/bin/runapi'; spawn(cmd, ['start'], {stdio: 'inherit', env: {...process.env, PYTHONIOENCODING: 'utf-8', PYTHONUTF8: '1'}});"
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const os = require('os'); const cmd = os.platform() === 'win32' ? 'venv\\Scripts\\runapi.exe' : 'venv/bin/runapi'; spawn(cmd, ['dev'], {stdio: 'inherit', env: {...process.env, PYTHONIOENCODING: 'utf-8', PYTHONUTF8: '1'}});"
scripts.install: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const os = require('os'); const cmd = os.platform() === 'win32' ? 'venv\\Scripts\\pip.exe' : 'venv/bin/pip'; spawn(cmd, ['install', 'runapi'], {stdio: 'inherit'});"
scripts.test: python -c "import subprocess, sys, os; venv_python = 'venv\\\\Scripts\\\\python.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else 'venv/bin/python'; subprocess.run([venv_python, '-m', 'pytest'])"
scripts.freeze: python -c "import subprocess, sys, os; pip_cmd = 'venv\\\\Scripts\\\\pip.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else 'venv/bin/pip'; subprocess.run([pip_cmd, 'freeze'])"
